correctness.rationale: The dimension-four hypergeometric radial factor is exactly (m+2-mt)/2. Three independent beta integrals give the meromorphic gamma identity (1). A complete real-line sign partition shows positivity for s>=-2 and -4<s<-3, negative large-degree coefficients on the two intervening bands, degree-one negativity for noninteger s<-5, and genuine poles at every integer s<=-3. The m=0 coefficient is exactly one. Polynomial growth of reciprocal weights ensures local kernel convergence. A standalone checker verifies 144 exact beta moments and 144 independent terminating-formula evaluations but is not the universal proof.
